criteria.text: Continuation of care with benefit OR new start for a listed Table 1 diagnosis meeting its criteria.
Well-documented gabapentin intolerance, hypersensitivity, contraindication, or insufficient response despite an adequate trial at maximally tolerated dose.
Tried and failed at least one OR contraindication to ALL of: tricyclic antidepressants, capsaicin cream, lidocaine patch.
Tried and failed at least one OR contraindication to ALL of: tricyclic antidepressants, an opioid, SNRI antidepressants, antiepileptic drugs (carbamazepine, phenytoin, or valproate).
Tried at least one other medication (other than gabapentin) labeled for fibromyalgia OR supported by published clinical evidence of safe and effective fibromyalgia use; evidence must be submitted.
Adult partial onset seizures: concurrently taking at least one other antiepileptic drug with insufficient response at maximally tolerated dose.
No concomitant Lyrica and gabapentin (required on all approval paths).

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Lyrica (pregabalin), Schedule V. Capsules: 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 225, 300 mg; oral solution: 20 mg/mL.
Version 1; Last updated 4/6/2016; Approved 4/29/2016; Effective for Dates of Service 10/3/2016 and thereafter.

Continuation of care with benefit is an independent approval path, including off-list diagnoses under the explicit denial exception. New starts require one of six closed indications and its Table 1 criteria. Concomitant gabapentin is excluded on every path. Adult adjunctive partial onset seizures are represented by the indication and concurrent AED attestation; no gabapentin step applies.

Table 2 negative wording for alternative therapy is interpreted as the inverse of Table 1 approval: one failed alternative OR contraindication to ALL listed alternatives. Treatment history and supporting documentation require manual review.
Reauthorization (notes only): meets initial criteria AND documented positive clinical response; denial if initial criteria not met OR no documented positive clinical response.
Authorization (notes only): initial up to 6 months; reauthorization up to 1 year.

Quantity limits (notes only): 50, 75, 100, 150, 200 mg capsules: 3 capsules/day; 225, 300 mg capsules: 2 capsules/day; 20 mg/mL solution: 30 mL/day. No quantity limit specified for 25 mg capsules. max_units is null.

Mechanism of action and references are retained in the full extracted source for context only; no predicates. Documentation verification, reauthorization, duration and quantity enforcement require manual review.
